Hey, glad to watch your update and to see your average heart rate start coming down! Hopefully the other numbers will come down naturally before you get to your 90 days. I wasn't on any medications when I started my Carnivore journey, so the main digestive change I had was reduced frequency of bowel movements because I wasn't adding enough fats, but there is just so much less waste eating this way. You will probably have another adjustment period after you are able to stop taking your medications as your body adjusts to having full control again.
I didn't think about it last week, but since GLP-1 medications mess with your digestion to trick your body into thinking it is satiated, maybe when you didn't take it your digestion got a little overactive? The side-effects of the medication do include those symptoms you mentioned. It looks like the side-effects would be most common when the dosage is changing. Eating meat and fats will naturally produce GLP-1 because you are properly satiated. 🙂
Another thing related to digestion, especially anyone that has taken antibiotics would be to try adding a little bit of fermented foods like Sauerkraut, or just the juice from it if eating strict carnivore to re-introduce some of the good bacteria killed by the antibiotics. Fermented dairy/yogurt has also been suggested, but dairy can be a slippery slope when trying to lose weight.
